title: Stock markets snap four-day rally amid profit booking; Trent tumbles over 12%
description: The 50-share NSE Nifty dipped 31.65 points, or 0.13%, to end at 24,398.70. Sensex and Nifty had rallied more than 2% in the last four sessions to hit more than two-month high levels on Monday (July 6, 2026)
